direct_findings.finding: IO fields unavailable because kernel lacks task accounting
direct_findings.evidence: v20.config SHA8b72287839477b99c008ad37a0756bf57ea50a24dad5c14682c29ea40c558841 hasTASKSTATS=n; TASK_IO_ACCOUNTING depends onTASK_XACCT→TASKSTATS. fs/proc/base.c registersio only underCONFIG_TASK_IO_ACCOUNTING.
direct_findings.conclusion: Emptyproc_io_delta is unavailable, not zeroIO. blkio_delay_ticks zero similarly cannot exonerateIO.

source_assessment.finding: Requesting the already active panel reuses it and sets parameters. A real warm switch comparison must leave mouse then return, not issue mouse twice.
A different panel is constructed withg_object_new; mouse→static→mouse recreates the media panel and can repeat setup costs even when libraries/files are warm.
Has a built-in Time to open panel debug timer around construction/content attachment. If exposed in one diagnostic new process, it measures synchronous panel construction, not asyncfirstpaint.

GDK warning means make_current returnedfalse. GTK GStreamer initialization calls that operation and creates a sharedGst context; this is a plausible failing path, but no stack proves this exact warning callsite.

libGLESv2_PVR_MESA containsOptimise program andlibsrv_um contains(dwt), consistent with1.16CPU-second Optimise p(dwt) worker being driverprogram optimization. This is a hypothesis without thread stack, not a confirmedshadercompiler attribution.
